answer: Each arriving agent must bond a scarce resource it cannot fake at scale, a traced gram of saffron from one named harvest or a metered joule of compute, and register that bond against a rotating public anchor of unique proofs. Duplicating a persona then needs a second harvest or a second joule, so a sybil cluster costs linearly more than the honest agent it mimics, while revocation drains the bonded nectar of standing the clone never earned.
